resolutions.researcher_notes: StartYear1=2028 supported. Aramco's June 2024 award of 15 LSTK contracts (~$8.8bn) launched Master Gas System phase-3 (MGS-3), targeting completion/capacity add by 2028. SPA (Saudi gov wire), World Oil and OGJ all state the network capacity raise (+3.15 bscfd) will be achieved 'by 2028'; OGJ/industry profiles put commissioning in Q4 2028. Original current_ref (aramco.com press release) is live in browser but times out under url_verifier (bot protection), so cited the verified independents instead. No contradiction to the 2028 value.

StartCountryOrArea=EndCountryOrArea=Saudi Arabia supported. SPA states MGS-3 delivers natural gas to customers 'across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia'; World Oil confirms the ~4,000 km of new pipelines lie within Saudi Arabia. Sources support the country-level location only, not the specific 'Jeddah' segment endpoint (no independent source pins that segment's endpoints), but the value cells requiring corroboration (StartCountryOrArea / EndCountryOrArea) are both satisfied.

Owner1=Aramco 100% supported. MGS-3 is Aramco's Master Gas System expansion; Aramco awarded the 15 LSTK pipeline contracts and owns/operates the national gas transport network. SPA, OGJ (Aramco awards Sinopec-unit MGS-3 pipeline contract) and World Oil all identify Aramco as the project principal. No competing ownership stake found; 100% Aramco is consistent.
